note: One contract read by Python (config/system_contract.py), Node (config/js/system_contract.js) and Rust (include_str!). Tests prove all three agree.

data_children._note: Directory names under DATA_ROOT owned by the native runtimes (paper_matching: the 模擬下單 orders paper_account_api writes and the results Rust B writes, docs/system-architecture/11). market_sessions is the one file named here: market_runtime writes it (the Shioaji sessions that opened on their first print and the closures it observed, native/market_runtime/src/rollover.rs MarketSessions), analysis_runtime and config/market_holidays.py read it. us_trading_calendar: the Futu provider writes the US exchange calendar OpenD published (service/market/futu/trading_calendar.py); market_runtime and config/market_holidays.py read it. traded_codes: each account ledger writes <ledger>.json there (the codes it traded, service/account/account_ledger_service.py publish_traded_codes); the historical store's manager (run by analysis_runtime) keeps their raw history forever. rollover_cutoffs: market_runtime writes its session rollover cutoffs there whenever they move; the historical store's manager (native/market_runtime/src/historical_store.rs, run by analysis_runtime and its materialization jobs) judges retention against them. voided_events: the durable events of market_runtime's stream the user decided are void, written by hand (native/market_runtime/src/voided.rs); market_runtime, analysis_runtime and its materialization jobs read it, and it lives with the WAL whose sequences it names. live-engine is where market_runtime's WAL/checkpoints have always lived; the materializer, reset tooling and storage layout read the same name.
